title: FBI Photo B21
what_is_it: A monochrome still image captured by a U.S. military sensor system, submitted by the FBI to the All-domain Anomaly Resolution Office (AARO) as an unidentified anomalous phenomenon (UAP) report.
interpretation_warnings: The image was redacted by the FBI before submission to AARO, meaning potentially identifying details (HUD data, coordinates, system identifiers) were removed before independent review
No accompanying mission report was provided, making this a single-source image with no corroborating operational context
The displayed timestamp (12/31/99) is a default/unset system clock value, so the actual date and time of capture are unknown from the image alone
The narrative description explicitly states it should not be interpreted as an analytical judgment or investigative conclusion
The source text extracted from the PDF is largely unintelligible due to OCR artifacts and redactions, leaving metadata as the primary information source
Single observer report — the operator could not identify the objects but no additional analysis or sensor correlation is referenced

verifiable_claims.claim: The displayed date of 12/31/99 is incorrect because the system clock was not set
verifiable_claims.source_quote: The date in the image is incorrect due to system date/time not being set
